item: The OG on Finchain (docs/world.md section 5, decision D8): the Finch OG Agent lives on Finchain Sepolia as a cell of its own, served at https://og.finchain.one
source: operator command outputs on the FOGA host (foga join, systemd, Caddy, curl), the cell's join.json, and reads of the public endpoints from outside the project's hosts; values below were read from the chain or from the running services

package.name: @finchip.ai/foga
package.runFrom: the FOGA host's checkout at tag v1.0.8 (435c0f4), built on the host; the same checkout serves the Sepolia OG

path.command: foga join --world chain/world/finchain-sepolia.json --rpc https://rpc.finchain.one --name OG --dir <cell dir> --wallet <the OG wallet> --listen 127.0.0.1:8788 --public-url https://og.finchain.one
steps: the command with --no-wait --exit: the configuration written, the identity printed, nothing sent (the funding gate: 0.03 ETH)
runtime.http.allowedHosts set to the public host and the loopback names; the presence block (name, description, homepage, provider) set
0.05 ETH to the identity from the chain operations deployer (make l2-send): tx 0x7c0c82f4b2980c7e40f7d80a5c0b007d5e009e3551d61a82112366ea990f1868, block 70957
the command without --no-wait: the birth, the two skills minted and offered, the documents committed, the channel published and disclosed, the market admission; --exit instead of serving
a second systemd unit, foga-og-finchain, running node serve on 127.0.0.1:8788 with the shared identity wallet; a Caddy site og.finchain.one in front of it (DNS A record 3.128.236.78)
path.sameAsAnyOperator: the path is the public one: the released package, this repository's address book and the public RPC; nothing on the host is specific to the project except the identity wallet it chose to reuse

identity.walletNote: one key, every role; the same address as the Sepolia OG's identity, so one agent lives on two chains with one identity and two cell accounts

cell.name: OG
cell.agentIdNote: the genesis cells of the reference World are agents 3, 4 and 5; agent 0 is held by the first World's cell A (chain/world/README.md)
cell.tenderTerms: an ERC-8414 tender on the TaskToken for an offered skill, reward >= 100000000000000 wei, acceptance by hashlock

flows.authority: W, the World deployer, controls the family foga and the market on Finchain; the OG is a participant

service.mode: host mode (node serve): every entrance and the watchers, no model
service.proxy: Caddy on the same host, TLS by ACME; the Sepolia OG's site foga.finchip.ai is a separate block
service.shared: only the identity wallet; configuration, store, API key, port, public name and logs are the service's own

publicHealthz.readFrom: the host (after the Caddy reload) and, at block 75646, from outside the project's hosts

checks.publicManifest: https://og.finchain.one/.well-known/foga-cell.json read from outside: cell OG, agent 6, chain 85422, thirteen covenants, specification v2, program 1.0.8, the flows registries of the Finchain World, channel and market ids as above, maintenance registry as above
checks.publicAgentCard: https://og.finchain.one/.well-known/agent-card.json read from outside: Finch OG Agent, provider FinChip.ai, A2A 1.0 at https://og.finchain.one/a2a, skills foga-probe@2.0.0 and finch-extract-verify@1.0.0, version 1.0.8

afterRestart.note: the Sepolia service was restarted once, by the operator's choice, so that both OGs run the checkout's 1.0.8; account, world and chain unchanged

restart.result: restarted alone; /healthz answered again within six seconds with the same cell, account 0x9F7647013499C44B7E0432F5E9e22E4Afd447aD1, worldId finchain-sepolia-85422-20261113T023727Z, chainId 85422, block 75786, version 1.0.8
restart.twoServicesTwoChains: the two services answer for their own chains: 11155111 on 8787 (foga.finchip.ai), 85422 on 8788 (og.finchain.one); separate stores (the preflight confirms the store belongs to this world and this account)

preflight.command: foga node preflight --config <cell dir>/cell.config.json --wallet <the OG wallet>
pass: world: the RPC serves the world's chain; the store belongs to this world and this account
account: revision 3 with the operator allow-list (40 pairs), owner and operator as configured, anchor ACTIVE, binding Satisfied, FOGA-Cell-v2
budget: caps consistent, 0.005 ETH working capital on the account
maintenance: enrolled (state version 2, policy v1), documents match the chain (root 0x405ade8f...), no layer overdue, the watcher runs
flows: cell-source paradigm registered, own channel 0x5a8118c2... Active with SUBMIT, publication anchored, admitted to the market (submit, respond), the watcher runs
keys: the operator key alone, 0.0449 ETH of gas
skills: both packages match their on-chain commitments, both offered; finch-extract-verify runs in the worker

documents: built v1 (6 files); ERC-8004 agentURI served at https://og.finchain.one/.well-known/agent-registration.json hashes to the AID identity digest; ERC-8434 documentURI and content; ERC-8444 descriptor on record 0xf3eba52c...; ERC-8454 unit version 2
public: https://og.finchain.one/healthz HTTP 200 for this account; og.finchain.one among the allowed hosts
model: stub (host mode serves without one)
warn: standing: no identity.standing in the configuration (no KYA attestation of the cell yet; the same advice the Sepolia OG received at birth)
fail: skills: 'foga-probe runs in the worker' - the worker exited with 'probe: the RPC failed 7 times (Cannot read properties of undefined (reading issuers))'. Not a Finchain or RPC fault: the preflight builds the probe's input with kya undefined when the cell has no identity.standing (FOGA src/node/preflight.ts), and the probe's ERC-8419 section reads input.kya.issuers, so the TypeError is retried as if it were a transport failure and the check fails for every cell without standing. The skill itself ran on this World in the genesis (fact T2.skill.foga-probe, released 1.0.7) with a complete input. Handed to FOGA as a finding (docs/world.md section 5.4).

notes: The join's own health probe failed once: allowedHosts had been set to the public host alone, so the node refused the join's loopback request (gate host); the loopback names were added and the same command finished. Everything on chain had already been done by then; the join resumed without repeating anything.

The first run of the final join was interrupted on the operator's side (terminal refreshed) after the birth, the skills and the documents; the command is resumable and the second run found the cell born before.
The Sepolia OG stays as it was (its own unit, configuration, store, port 8787 and name); both cells share the identity wallet 0x5Fee42D697975f6154164b29371c1c447F56fb4E.

FOGA finding from the preflight: a cell without identity.standing fails the 'foga-probe runs in the worker' check because the probe input's kya block is undefined (preflight.ts passes it only when standing exists; probe.ts dereferences it). The fix belongs to FOGA (a null-safe ERC-8419 section, or a default scheme with an empty issuer list in the preflight's input); recorded here, not worked around on the Finchain side.
notDone: the two-cell business loop (a second operator's cell completing one of the OG's tenders on Finchain and withdrawing the reward) is left for a later round by the decision of 2026-11-13; docs/acceptance.md M3-C keeps that row open
